description: Send one real request to a RailCore API read endpoint with your account and return its answer: status, request ID, requests counted and left, and the response body. It counts against your plan like any API request, so ask the user first. max_requests caps what it may count (default 1); a request that would count more is refused before it is sent. At most 30 tries an hour. Requires sign-in to your RailCore account. The first try also asks permission to make test requests.

body.description: The JSON body as text, for the two POST endpoints only (batch-seat-availability, compare-journeys), such as {"journeys": [{"from": "BSL", "to": "ADI", "date": "2026-12-01"}]}.

endpoint.description: A read endpoint: an id (search-stations), a method and path (GET /stations/search) or a URL.

max_requests.description: The most requests this try may count, 1 to 25. Default 1. Raise it only after the user agrees to the cost.

params.description: Path and query parameters by name, every value as a string, such as {"q": "pune", "limit": "5"} or {"train_number": "12951"}. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: try_endpoint

body_json.description: The response body as text, cut near 32 KB.

quoted_requests.description: What this request was expected to count, before it was sent.

url.description: The public URL of the same request.

title: Try a RailCore API endpoint
